Pair devices to sessions using short hex codes — scan and sync across mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Desktop requests a pairing code for its session Code is displayed on screen (6-char hex, 5-minute TTL) Mobile enters the code to validate and pair Server links the mobile device to the desktop's session Both devices can now access the same conversation
Codes are single-use — reusing returns {"valid": false, "error": "Code already used"} Codes expire after 5 minutes (configurable TTL) Max 5 devices per session (configurable)

Endpoint Method Description /api/pairing/create POST Generate a pairing code /api/pairing/validate POST Validate and consume a code /api/pairing/devices GET List paired devices for session /api/pairing/devices/{id} DELETE Remove a paired device
Sessions — Sessions that paired devices share
